en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a large cargo or passenger ship named 'GOONAWARRA' sailing on calm waters. The ship has a classic early-to-mid 20th-century design, with a prominent funnel, multiple masts, and a clean, streamlined hull. In the lower left corner, text identifies the ship's name and the shipping company: 'm.s. GOONAWARRA, Rederi A.B. Transatlantic.' The background is a low, indistinct shoreline under a cloudy sky.
